title: First-run local model chosen and fetched for this hardware
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. On first run pick the best model that fits RAM/VRAM/disk, download it resumably with progress, and fall back cleanly offline. Tests zc_first_model_* over a table of hardware profiles.
